name: Imperial Valley Computer Manufacturing Data Center
additional_info: [Stage updated 2026-08-31: Imperial County stated that Superior Court ordered the County to set aside its data center moratorium; the project-specific developer was the plaintiff in the case, removing the countywide approval hold, though broader policy review continues.] [Stage updated 2026-09-07: Imperial County Superior Court tentatively ordered the County to set aside key approvals and prepare a full environmental impact report before processing permits for the proposed 330 MW project.]
source: TechRadar (2026-07-29) | Imperial County (2026-08-28) | Data Center Knowledge (2026-09-01)

name: DataBank and Goodman Group Los Angeles Data Center
transmission_utility: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP)
additional_info: DataBank and Goodman Group have announced a joint venture to develop a 32MW data center in Vernon, Los Angeles, to meet growing demand from cloud, AI, and enterprise customers.

name: Project North Bay Solutions Data Center
additional_info: Investor materials describe a proposed 150 MW expandable data center within a 300-acre industrial campus. Canon Partners owns the site and confirmed it is considering a data center; Fairfield has not received a specific subsequent development application beyond the 2023 master-planned industrial-park permit.
address: Between Vanden Road and North Gate Road, Fairfield, CA
transmission_upgrades.description: Project materials indicate PG&E began an engineering study in Q3 2025 and issued an engineering agreement in December 2025; Canon Partners is evaluating the cost of PG&E infrastructure needed for high-power load service.

name: Link Logistics Southeast Sacramento Data Center
additional_info: Link Logistics, a Blackstone subsidiary, is in discussions with SMUD regarding a proposed data center in southeastern Sacramento. SMUD characterized it as a large-load project exceeding 50 MW. The developer would still require City of Sacramento entitlements and approvals; backers reportedly target operations by early 2029.
address: Depot Park industrial complex, near Fruitridge Road and Florin Perkins Road, Sacramento
exact_location.nearest_intersection: Fruitridge Road and Florin Perkins Road

name: Blackstart Digital Almaden Research Center Data Center Redevelopment
ownership_transfers: Blackstart Digital is acquiring the former IBM Almaden Research Center; transaction was expected to close before the end of 2026.
additional_info: Blackstart Digital has filed for environmental review to renovate the 35-acre former IBM research campus at 650 Harry Road for data-center redevelopment. The seven-building campus totals more than 500,000 square feet, has existing data-center space, and is served by a 25 MW substation that Blackstart aims to expand.

name: Manchester Financial Group NAVWAR Data Center
phase: Potential 400 MW data-center component of NAVWAR redevelopment
additional_info: Manchester Financial Group is exploring a potential 400 MW data center on roughly 70 acres of the federal NAVWAR Old Town Campus redevelopment site. No final project design or approval has been announced.
address: NAVWAR Old Town Campus, San Diego, CA

name: San Francisco Centre AI Data Center Conversion
additional_info: KG Growth Partners confirmed it is evaluating conversion of the former Bloomingdale's portion of San Francisco Centre, potentially with other mall space, into a data center for an unnamed AI lab. No property transaction or city application has been completed.
address: San Francisco Centre, 845 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94103

name: RB Inyokern Data Center
additional_info: Proposed 99 MW hyperscale cloud and AI data center on approximately 50 acres. The California Energy Commission began CEQA EIR review on November 5, 2026 for the associated small power plant exemption application. The project includes a customer-owned 115/34.5 kV substation, six modular data halls, and 40 emergency diesel generators serving up to 99 MW of backup load.
address: Northwest quadrant of State Route 178 (West Inyokern Road) and U.S. Highway 395, Inyokern, Kern County, CA
exact_location.nearest_intersection: State Route 178 (West Inyokern Road) and U.S. Highway 395
transmission_upgrades.description: Two SCE-constructed 115 kV overhead subtransmission lines and associated electrical infrastructure are proposed between the existing Inyokern Substation and the project point of interconnection.
